SELECT
  m.met_id,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.enzyme_name,
  sub_rec.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  par_rec.compound_name AS parent_name,
  sub_str.canonical_smiles AS substrate_smiles,
  par_str.canonical_smiles AS parent_smiles
FROM metabolism m
INNER JOIN compound_records sub_rec
  ON m.substrate_record_id = sub_rec.record_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary sub
  ON sub_rec.molregno = sub.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures sub_str
  ON sub.molregno = sub_str.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_records par_rec
  ON m.drug_record_id = par_rec.record_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary par
  ON par_rec.molregno = par.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures par_str
  ON par.molregno = par_str.molregno
WHERE m.tax_id = 9483
ORDER BY m.met_id ASC
LIMIT 200;
